scope: One static cardinal sheet only; no diagonal, complete360, archival, native mesh, rig or runtime approval.

checks.finding: Actual uploaded reference and full output compared: short tight curls, black rectangular glasses, trimmed beard/moustache, warm-brown skin, adult proportions and the same detailed blue/orange/cream/brown materials in gray studio lighting.

Closed navy parka, neck warmer, down fleece hood, orange shoulder/zipper/hem/pocket accents, cargo trousers/knee pads and capped lace-up boots preserved. No pack, belt, harness, pouch or weapon. Rear has plain coat and down hood, without a repeated front zipper or front patch pockets.
Actual front, left profile, rear and right profile are present in correct 2x2 order. Nose direction, heel/toe geometry, coat opening and rear hood establish real opposing views.

Two arms and legs, coherent shoulder/elbow/wrist placement, aligned head and torso, flat boots. Both end-on profile hands show four fingers plus a thumb; front/rear edge-on overlap is natural and matches palm-down T-pose. No visibly exposed wrong digit count or detached parts.

All fingertips and boots inside each quadrant, consistent figure height and soft ground shadows; titles and angle captions legible. Native1254x1254 output is smaller than requested2048 but actual face/hand geometry remains reviewable. No upscaling or native2048 claim.
